title: External agent frameworks under kill, approval and restart (E1-E5)
summary: Nine external frameworks and stack-agent with a scripted fake model: kills inside effects, approvals across restarts, overhead.

results.E2_charges_after_kill_inside_effect_W2: 2 for LangGraph (5/5), OpenAI SDK, Agno, smolagents, Letta, MAF, CrewAI, Pydantic AI (ledger-flagged) and OpenHands; stack-agent: stuck
results.finding: Every external framework tested repeats a side effect when the process dies inside it (W2)
results.E3_approval: survived restart in 6 frameworks; approve-then-crash re-executed in all 3 that ran it (OpenAI SDK, Agno, OpenHands)

limitations: Most windows were run once; LangGraph ran 5
version skew for Letta and Pydantic AI

reproduce.command: per-framework virtualenv commands in each README

comparability: Scripted fake model; stack-agent then was before P1-P4.
